'''Pantora''' was the principal [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]' [[Pantora system/Legends|Pantora system]], [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Water/Legends|ice]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orto Plutonia/Legends|Orto Plutonia]]. Pantora was covered by terrestrial land, with marshes on the outskirts of its [[City/Legends|cities]]. It was a member of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and had full senatorial representation on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==History==
[[File:Pantoran_city.png|thumb|left|250px|A city on Pantora.]]
Beginning as a feudal system of government, Pantora eventually developed a democratically elected government, presided over by the [[Pantoran Assembly/Legends|Pantoran Assembly]] which was in turn led by the [[Chairman/Legends|Chairman]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the manipulative [[Chi Cho/Legends|Chi Cho]] at the time ruled over Pantora as chairman. The moon was represented in [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] by the young female [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Riyo Chuchi/Legends|Riyo Chuchi]]. An influential moon, Pantora was able to request and receive a [[Glid Station/Legends|Republic outpost]] within its [[Star system/Legends|system]] as a measure of protection against the CIS forces during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Trespass" />

Initially thought to be the only inhabited world in the system, Pantora orbited the ice world of [[Orto Plutonia/Legends|Orto Plutonia]], which was a [[Protectorate (government system)/Legends|protectorate]] of the [[Pantoran/Legends|Pantorans]] and&mdash;unknown to them&mdash;a home to a [[Talz/Legends|Talz]] colony. When the existence of Talz was discovered, the planet was granted sovereignty&mdash;though [[Chairman/Legends|Chairman]] Cho fiercely opposed the measure and started the [[Battle of Orto Plutonia/Legends|One-Day War]] with the Talz. However, Senator Chuchi intervened at the behest of the Pantoran Assembly and, in respect of the Talz's wishes to be left alone, she recalled the Pantoran and Republic presence from the ice world and returned to Pantora.<ref name="Trespass" /> Not long after, [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Notluwiski Papanoida/Legends|Notluwiski Papanoida]] became the new [[Chairman/Legends|Chairman]] of Pantora.<ref name="EG:SOI">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode304.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Sphere of Influence}}</ref>

[[File:Pantora_travel_advertisement.png|thumb|150px|A travel advertisement for Pantora.]]

Later in the war, Pantora was [[Blockade of Pantora/Legends|blockaded]] by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] under the command of [[Lott Dod/Legends|Lott Dod]] to force Pantora to join the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]]. The blockade led to violent riots and calls to join the CIS in desperation. Papanoida managed to overcome the crisis after his daughters were kidnapped and held as leverage, with the help of Senator Chuchi and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], who aided him in their rescue. Chuchi successfully negotiated with the Trade Federation ambassador to end the blockade and resume trade relations after she threatened to blackmail him and expose his alliance with the Separatists.<ref name="Sphere of Influence" />

When the Republic collapsed and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] seized control of the galaxy, Pantora was cut off from the rest of the galaxy. Struggling to come to grips with their new predicament, the Pantoran Assembly split into three factions: the Appeasers, the Republicans, and the Expansionists. The first group believed that integrating with the Empire was the only path to security and economic strength, while the traditionalist Republicans believed the Empire stood in stark opposition to the core principles and values of the Pantoran culture. The Expansionists argued that the forging of treaties with the old slaving and spice trading worlds around them would be their salvation. The Expansionists were the smallest in number, and their position was viewed as abhorrent by most Pantorans.<ref name="EV" />

Building up a small navy of volunteers, the Assembly cautiously expanded; careful to avoid drawing Imperial attention to their work. Rogue members of the Assembly began to hire [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] and make unofficial deals to free up the flow of information technologies and resources. Despite the vast resources available on Orto Plutonia, Senator Chuchi's treaty still stood, protecting the Talz from Pantoran interference. While many on the Assembly wished to respect the Treaty, others sought to educate the Talz in hopes of integrating the two societies and sharing resources.<ref name="EV" />
